en-US.title: Today Ad Trend: Ad Briefing
en-US.subtitle: Your 3-minute marketing brief
en-US.promoText: What changed in advertising today, and what it means for your campaigns. A finishable daily brief for performance, UA and brand marketers.
en-US.description:
Today Ad Trend is a 3-minute daily briefing for people who run ads.

Every morning you get 5–7 things that actually changed in advertising, picked for your role, each with a one-line "so what": what it means for your campaigns and what to check. Read them, and you're done for the day.

BUILT FOR YOUR JOB
Choose your brief once:
• Performance marketer: paid social and search, bidding, measurement, CPA and ROAS
• UA / app marketer: app installs, MMPs, SKAN and AdAttributionKit, app ad networks
• Brand & creative marketer: messaging, creative, campaigns, what competitors run

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Today: a short, finishable brief with a "so what" for every item and a daily streak
• Platforms: official product and policy updates from the major ad platforms
• News: the day’s stories from leading ad-industry publications
• Experts: new posts from well-known marketing and growth writers
• Creative Pulse: a weekly read on what advertisers launch, based on public ad transparency data: format mix, audience targeting, top launchers and long-running ads
• Swipe file: save anything worth keeping
• Watchlist: follow brands, platforms or topics and see every mention

QUIET BY DESIGN
One optional reminder a day, at the time you pick, in your time zone. No account needed. Your settings, saved items and watchlist stay on your device.

Summaries and "so what" notes are AI-generated from public sources. Every item links to the original publisher.
